58009290.title: #01 Classic Wash
58009290.description:
Hand washing of the bodywork with pH-neutral foam, with a focus on paintwork safety. 
 After the foam is applied, the wheel arches are cleaned, the vehicle is rinsed, dried with microfiber towels, and the tires are treated with tire dressing for a deep black finish.

58009452.title: #02 Two-Phase Wash
58009452.description:
Two-phase hand wash with active foam, thorough body cleaning, and tire treatment. 
 Ideal for vehicles with a higher level of dirt contamination.

58009540.title: #03 Three-Phase Washing
58009540.description:
Premium three-stage hand wash with detailed wheel cleaning and nano wax application. 
 This service combines double foam application, manual body washing, and final paintwork treatment for a flawless appearance.

58009762.title: #04 Detailing Wash
58009762.description: Comprehensive detailing wash with professional interior and exterior care, focused on every detail. The result is a refreshed, spotless vehicle with a premium finish and a showroom-like appearance.

58009942.title: #05 Interior Deep Cleaning + Standard Wash
58009942.description: Includes everything from the standard wash plus a complete deep interior cleaning with seat removal for maximum cleanliness and attention to detail.

58009984.title: #18 Engine Bay Cleaning
58009984.description: Professional cleaning and treatment of the engine bay with maximum care for electronic components.

58010022.title: #07 One-Step Paint Correction
58010022.description: Paint correction designed to restore paint depth and gloss while removing minor scratches and oxidation.

58010077.title: #08 Two-Step Paint Correction
58010077.description: Comprehensive paint correction for deep restoration of the paintwork and a mirror-like shine.

58010123.title: #09 Three-Step Paint Correction (Premium Correction)
58010123.description: The highest level of paint restoration. Three-step correction removes deeper scratches and gives the bodywork a flawless mirror finish.

58010450.title: #10 Full Paint Correction & Ceramic Protection
58010450.description: Premium treatment for complete paint restoration and protection. The combination of three-step polishing and ceramic coating application delivers exceptional gloss and long-lasting protection.

58010520.title: #11 Premium Hard Wax Application
58010520.description: Premium treatment that gives the bodywork deep gloss and a hydrophobic effect lasting up to three months.

58010932.title: #12 Chrome Delete — Converting Chrome Elements to Gloss or Matte Black
58010932.description:
A modern styling upgrade that gives the vehicle a more aggressive, luxurious, and personalized appearance. 
 For individual chrome elements, pricing is provided individually.

58010975.title: #13 Front & Rear Headlight Polishing
58010975.description: Restores headlight clarity for improved brightness and a cleaner overall vehicle appearance.

58011090.title: #14 Headlight Polishing & Protection with Protective or Tint Film
58011090.description:
Comprehensive headlight restoration and long-term protection. Provides a clean appearance, modern styling effect, and durability for several years. 
 (If only film protection or tinting is required without polishing, pricing is calculated individually.)

58011788.title: #15 Paintless Dent Repair (PDR)
58011788.description:
Professional dent repair without damaging the original paintwork. 
 Paintless Dent Repair (PDR) technology allows dents to be removed quickly and precisely without filler or repainting.

58012150.title: #16 Scratch Removal Without Repainting (Smart Repair)
58012150.description:
Modern localized paint repair technology without the need to repaint the entire panel. 
 Smart Repair allows even deeper scratches reaching the metal surface to be removed while preserving the original paint color.

58012905.title: #17 Window Tinting with Thermal & Chameleon Films
58012905.description: Professional window tinting using modern films that improve vehicle appearance, enhance comfort, provide protection, and add a distinctive premium style.

58017002.title: #01 Oil & Filter Change
58017002.description: We replace the oil according to the manufacturer’s specifications — without compromising on the quality of the oil or filters. We work quickly, professionally, and at a fair price.

58042342.title: #02 Oil & Filter Change (Custom Parts)
58042342.description: We will replace the oil and filter according to the manufacturer’s specifications using your own parts. We guarantee professional service, careful workmanship, and fair pricing.

58042544.title: #03 Power Steering / Differential / Transfer Case Oil Change
58042544.description: We replace the fluid in the power steering system, differential, and transfer case according to the manufacturer’s specifications. Prices start from 2999 CZK (valid for most vehicles). For an exact quote, please contact our service advisor.

58042631.title: #04 Changing the oil in the manual transmission
58042631.description: The listed price does not include transmission fluid, filters, or other spare parts and is valid when parts are purchased through DBS Service.

58042708.title: #05 Changing the oil in the automatic transmission
58042708.description: The listed prices include spare parts and apply when materials and components are purchased through DBS Service. For a precise quotation, please contact our service advisor — the final price is calculated individually depending on the vehicle model and scope of work (from 4 999 CZK up to 29 999 CZK for selected premium vehicles).

58042772.title: #06 Partial Automatic Transmission Fluid Change
58042772.description: Recommended if you are unsure when the transmission fluid was last changed or if the gearbox has started to shift with slight jerks. Prices range from 2 999 CZK to 14 999 CZK depending on the transmission type and vehicle model. For an exact quotation, please contact our service advisor.

58042986.title: #07 Brake Pad Replacement (1 Axle)
58042986.description: We replace brake pads on one axle according to the manufacturer’s specifications and inspect the condition of the brake discs and the entire braking system. The listed prices include spare parts and are valid when materials and parts are purchased through DBS Service.

58043237.title: #08 Brake Pad Replacement (1 Axle)
58043237.description: We replace brake discs and pads on one axle according to the manufacturer’s specifications and inspect the braking system. The listed prices include spare parts and are valid when materials and parts are purchased through DBS Service.

58043315.title: #09 Brake Disc / Pad Replacement (1 Axle | Your Parts)
58043315.description: If you bring your own parts, we will replace the brake discs or pads on one axle.

58043394.title: #10 Brake Fluid Replacement (Labor Only)
58043394.description: Manufacturers recommend replacing brake fluid every 2 years. If you are unsure when it was last changed, we can check its condition free of charge — including moisture content and whether replacement is necessary. The listed price covers labor only; brake fluid is not included.

58043585.title: #11 Timing Belt Kit Replacement
58043585.description: We provide professional timing belt kit replacement according to the manufacturer’s specifications. The listed price does not include the timing belt kit or other spare parts and is valid when parts are purchased through DBS Service. Prices start from 4 999 CZK. For an exact quotation, please contact our service advisor.

58043650.title: #12 Timing Chain Kit Replacement (Without Engine Removal)
58043650.description: We provide professional timing chain kit replacement without engine removal according to the manufacturer’s specifications. The listed price does not include the timing chain kit or other spare parts and is valid when parts are purchased through DBS Service. Prices start from 5 999 CZK. For an exact quotation, please contact our service advisor.

58043702.title: #13 Engine Removal / Installation
58043702.description: The price may be lower if the service is combined with additional repair work. Final pricing is calculated individually depending on the vehicle model and scope of work. For an exact quotation, please contact our service advisor.

58043784.title: #14 Coolant replacement
58043784.description: Before replacement, we check whether the correct type of coolant is used in your vehicle according to the manufacturer’s specifications. If an incorrect coolant is detected, we will recommend the appropriate type and provide an individual quotation. In all other cases, a fixed labor price applies, excluding materials.

58043901.title: #15 Transmission Removal / Installation & Clutch Kit Replacement
58043901.description: We provide professional transmission removal and installation, along with clutch kit replacement according to the manufacturer’s specifications. All work is carried out with careful inspection of related components. The listed price does not include the clutch kit or other spare parts and is valid when parts are purchased through DBS Service.

58046282.title: #16 Wheel Alignment (Passenger Vehicle)
58046282.description: We approach every vehicle individually and find the most efficient way to perform wheel alignment with minimal unnecessary costs. If worn or damaged suspension components are detected, we provide a free consultation and repair cost estimate. We perform wheel alignment for all types of vehicles — accurately, professionally, and reliably.

58046323.title: #17 Wheel Alignment (Commercial Vehicles & SUVs)
58046323.description: We approach every vehicle individually and find the most efficient way to perform wheel alignment with minimal unnecessary costs. If worn or damaged suspension components are detected, we provide a free consultation and repair cost estimate. We perform wheel alignment for commercial vehicles and SUVs with precision, professionalism, and reliability.

58046978.title: #18 Mechanic Labor Hour
58046978.description: This item reflects the actual time spent on various repair works — such as shock absorber replacement, exhaust system repair or replacement, and other vehicle-specific services. Your invoice will include the exact number of labor hours and a detailed list of completed work. If needed, our service advisor will gladly explain the scope of the repairs.

58047192.title: #19 Mechanic Labor Hour (With Your Own Parts)
58047192.description: Labor costs are calculated according to the actual time spent by the mechanic. Your own parts are used for the repair or service. The invoice will include the exact number of labor hours and a detailed list of completed work.

58047390.title: #20 Air Conditioning Diagnostics
58047390.description: Contact us if your air conditioning system is not working properly or is not cooling efficiently. We will perform a complete system diagnostic, identify the cause of the issue, and recommend the most suitable and cost-effective solution based on our expert assessment.

58047448.title: #21 Regular Air Conditioning Service
58047448.description: Visit us for regular maintenance of your air conditioning system. The listed price covers labor only and does not include refrigerant, which is charged separately according to the actual amount refilled.

58047593.title: #22 Antibacterial Interior & Air Conditioning Treatment
58047593.description: We provide a complete antibacterial treatment of the vehicle interior and air conditioning system, effectively removing bacteria and mold accumulated on the A/C evaporator. The treatment also helps eliminate unpleasant odors from the ventilation system and ensures a fresh and healthy environment inside your vehicle.

57822361.title: #00 Special Offers | #1 Comprehensive vehicle diagnostics
57822361.description: 🔥 Independent Inspection 🔥 | We professionally assess the actual condition of your vehicle

58015267.title: #00 Special Offers | #3 Brake System Service
58015267.description: If you purchase front and rear brake discs and pads from us, you will not only receive high-quality parts from trusted manufacturers at a great price, but also professional installation completely free of charge!

58015985.title: #00 Special Offers | #4 Spark Plug Replacement
58015985.description: With a complete timing belt/chain kit replacement at DBS, spark plug replacement is included free of charge.

58015870.title: #00 Special Offers | #5 Complete clutch replacement
58015870.description: 10% Off Oil When Replacing A Complete Clutch Kit And Transmission Oil.

58015700.title: #00 Special Offers  | #6 Shock Absorber Replacement & Wheel Alignment
58015700.description:
When replacing all shock absorbers (front and rear) together with the top mounts, you receive a 50% discount on wheel alignment. 
 The listed wheel alignment price for passenger vehicles already includes the discount and does not include any additional suspension work.

58048440.title: #23 Comprehensive Vehicle Diagnostics (Including Computer Diagnostics)
58048440.description: We professionally assess the actual condition of your vehicle. The diagnostics include a computer scan of control units, inspection of the suspension, braking system, all operating fluids, engine and transmission sealing, headlights, and other electrical components. You will also receive photo documentation of the detected issues along with clear recommendations on what requires immediate attention and what can safely wait.

58048471.title: #24 Auto Electrician Labor Hour
58048471.description:
This service covers the time spent on all types of electrical work — from diagnostics and troubleshooting to electrical system repairs and installation of new components. The scope of work is always determined individually depending on the vehicle and the detected issue. 
 Your invoice will clearly show the exact labor time and a detailed list of completed services.

58048748.title: #25 Gasoline Engine Endoscopy
58048748.description: Using an endoscope, we inspect the condition of the cylinders and internal engine components to accurately assess the technical condition of your engine. This service is especially useful before purchasing a used vehicle or when engine wear is suspected. Prices start from 1,499 CZK depending on the number of cylinders.

58048773.title: #26 Battery Load Test
58048773.description: We test the actual condition of your battery using a professional load test. This helps determine how well the battery performs under load and how much starting power it can still deliver to ensure reliable starts in all conditions.

58049569.title: #27 Free Body Repair Inspection & Consultation
58049569.description: We offer a free consultation and initial inspection of body damage — from small parking dents to hail damage or accident-related repairs. Our specialists will assess the extent of the damage, recommend the most suitable repair method, and provide an estimated cost and repair timeframe. Our goal is to help you find the most effective and cost-efficient solution so you clearly understand the best next steps for your vehicle.

58049726.title: #28 Free Inspection & Consultation for Engine Overhaul
58049726.description: We provide a free initial engine inspection and expert consultation regarding the possibility of a complete engine overhaul. Our goal is to help you clearly understand whether the repair is worthwhile and which solution will be the most effective for your vehicle.

58049739.title: #29 Bodywork Labor Hour
58049739.description: The listed prices include spare parts and are valid when materials and parts are purchased through DBS Service.

58049765.title: #30 Windshield Replacement & Installation
58049765.description: We provide professional windshield replacement and installation according to manufacturer specifications and safety standards. We use high-quality adhesive materials and ensure precise installation for maximum safety and durability. The final price depends on the vehicle type and windshield specification — an exact quotation will be provided by our service advisor.

58049782.title: #31 Auto Painter Labor Hour
58049782.description: This service includes paintwork such as surface preparation, painting of individual body parts or the entire vehicle, and final polishing. The cost is calculated according to the actual time spent. Your invoice will include the exact scope and type of completed work.

58049829.title: #32 Comprehensive Vehicle Inspection & STK Preparation
58049829.description: We provide a complete vehicle inspection before the technical inspection (STK). We check the braking system, suspension, lighting, tires, fluids, and other key components to help avoid potential issues during the inspection process. After the inspection, you will receive clear recommendations for any necessary repairs or adjustments.
